basic.en: Good morning. How are you today?
basic.cn: 早上好。你今天怎么样？

basic.en: My name is Li Ming. I am a student.
basic.cn: 我叫李明。我是一名学生。

basic.en: I get up at seven every morning.
basic.cn: 我每天早上七点起床。

basic.en: Please open your books to page ten.
basic.cn: 请把书翻到第十页。

basic.en: Thank you very much for your help.
basic.cn: 非常感谢你的帮助。

basic.en: I would like a cup of tea, please.
basic.cn: 我想要一杯茶，谢谢。

basic.en: Excuse me, where is the bus station?
basic.cn: 打扰一下，公交车站在哪里？

basic.en: The weather is fine today, isn't it?
basic.cn: 今天天气不错，不是吗？

basic.en: I usually go to the library after class.
basic.cn: 我通常下课后去图书馆。

basic.en: Could you please say that again slowly?
basic.cn: 你能慢一点再说一遍吗？

basic.en: Learning English takes time and patience.
basic.cn: 学英语需要时间和耐心。

basic.en: He studies hard because he wants to pass the exam.
basic.cn: 他努力学习，因为他想通过考试。

basic.en: There are many books on the desk.
basic.cn: 桌子上有很多书。

basic.en: I have been learning English for three months.
basic.cn: 我学英语已经三个月了。

basic.en: Do you know how to get to the train station?
basic.cn: 你知道怎么去火车站吗？

basic.en: It is important to practice every day.
basic.cn: 每天练习是很重要的。

basic.en: She likes reading novels in her free time.
basic.cn: 她喜欢在空闲时间读小说。

basic.en: We will have a meeting tomorrow morning.
basic.cn: 我们明天上午有个会议。

basic.en: Please remember to turn off the lights.
basic.cn: 请记得关灯。

basic.en: The train leaves at eight o'clock sharp.
basic.cn: 火车八点整发车。

basic.en: I usually get up at six thirty in the morning.
basic.cn: 我通常早上六点半起床。

basic.en: My father works in a hospital near our home.
basic.cn: 我父亲在我们家附近的一家医院工作。

basic.en: There is a small park behind our school.
basic.cn: 我们学校后面有一个小公园。

basic.en: I like to read English stories before I go to bed.
basic.cn: 我喜欢睡前读英语故事。

basic.en: The bus is late again this morning.
basic.cn: 今天早上公交车又晚了。

basic.en: She is cooking dinner for her family.
basic.cn: 她正在为家人做晚饭。

basic.en: We have four classes in the morning.
basic.cn: 我们上午有四节课。

basic.en: Please close the window before you leave.
basic.cn: 离开前请关上窗户。

basic.en: I forgot to bring my notebook today.
basic.cn: 我今天忘了带笔记本。

basic.en: He can swim very well for his age.
basic.cn: 以他的年龄来说，他游得很好。

basic.en: It often rains here in early summer.
basic.cn: 这里初夏经常下雨。

basic.en: My sister is two years younger than me.
basic.cn: 我妹妹比我小两岁。

basic.en: I want to buy a new dictionary this week.
basic.cn: 我这周想买一本新词典。

basic.en: The library is very quiet in the afternoon.
basic.cn: 图书馆下午很安静。

basic.en: Do you know the way to the post office?
basic.cn: 你知道去邮局的路吗？

basic.en: We should drink more water every day.
basic.cn: 我们每天应该多喝水。

basic.en: He always finishes his homework before dinner.
basic.cn: 他总是在晚饭前完成作业。

basic.en: I am a little tired after the long walk.
basic.cn: 走了很久之后我有点累。

basic.en: The meeting will start at nine tomorrow morning.
basic.cn: 会议明天上午九点开始。

basic.en: She writes to her parents once a month.
basic.cn: 她每个月给父母写一次信。

basic.en: My brother is learning to play the guitar.
basic.cn: 我哥哥在学弹吉他。

basic.en: There are two apples left in the box.
basic.cn: 盒子里还剩两个苹果。

basic.en: I do not like coffee without milk.
basic.cn: 我不喜欢不加奶的咖啡。

basic.en: The teacher asked us to read the text aloud.
basic.cn: 老师让我们朗读课文。

basic.en: It takes twenty minutes to walk to the station.
basic.cn: 走到车站要二十分钟。

basic.en: Could you help me with this heavy box?
basic.cn: 你能帮我搬这个重箱子吗？

basic.en: We had a good time at the party last night.
basic.cn: 我们昨晚在聚会上玩得很开心。

basic.en: My mother usually goes to the market on Sunday.
basic.cn: 我妈妈通常在周日去市场。

basic.en: I have never been to Beijing before.
basic.cn: 我以前从没去过北京。

basic.en: The exam was easier than I expected.
basic.cn: 考试比我预期的容易。

basic.en: He lives in a small town near the sea.
basic.cn: 他住在海边的一个小镇上。

basic.en: Please turn down the music a little.
basic.cn: 请把音乐调小一点。

basic.en: I need to practise speaking English more.
basic.cn: 我需要多练习说英语。

basic.en: They are planning a trip for the summer holiday.
basic.cn: 他们在计划暑假的旅行。

basic.en: My watch is five minutes fast.
basic.cn: 我的表快了五分钟。

basic.en: We should keep our classroom clean and tidy.
basic.cn: 我们应该保持教室干净整洁。

basic.en: She looked happy when she got the news.
basic.cn: 她听到这个消息时看起来很开心。

basic.en: I will call you as soon as I arrive.
basic.cn: 我一到就给你打电话。

basic.en: The food in that restaurant is not expensive.
basic.cn: 那家餐馆的食物不贵。

basic.en: He is good at maths but weak in English.
basic.cn: 他数学好，但英语弱。

basic.en: Do not be afraid of making mistakes.
basic.cn: 不要害怕犯错误。

basic.en: It is cold outside, so wear a warm coat.
basic.cn: 外面很冷，所以穿件暖和的外套。

basic.en: My grandparents live in the countryside.
basic.cn: 我的祖父母住在乡下。

basic.en: I spent the whole evening on my report.
basic.cn: 我整个晚上都在写报告。

basic.en: The train arrived exactly on time.
basic.cn: 火车准点到达。

basic.en: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?
basic.cn: 我能借你的笔用一下吗？

basic.en: We must leave now or we will be late.
basic.cn: 我们必须现在就走，否则会迟到。

basic.en: He has worked in this company for five years.
basic.cn: 他在这家公司工作五年了。

basic.en: The price of fruit goes up in winter.
basic.cn: 冬天水果的价格会上涨。

basic.en: I would rather walk than take a taxi.
basic.cn: 我宁愿走路也不愿打车。

basic.en: She speaks English slowly but clearly.
basic.cn: 她说英语说得慢，但很清楚。

basic.en: There is nothing in the fridge.
basic.cn: 冰箱里什么也没有。

basic.en: My phone battery is almost dead.
basic.cn: 我的手机电池快没电了。

basic.en: He promised to help me with the moving.
basic.cn: 他答应帮我搬家。

basic.en: The children are playing football on the playground.
basic.cn: 孩子们在操场上踢足球。

basic.en: I have to finish this work before Friday.
basic.cn: 我必须在周五前完成这项工作。

basic.en: Reading good books is a way to relax.
basic.cn: 读好书是一种放松的方式。

basic.en: The shop opens at eight in the morning.
basic.cn: 这家店早上八点开门。

basic.en: She did not come to class because she was ill.
basic.cn: 她因为生病没来上课。

basic.en: Try to speak English every chance you get.
basic.cn: 抓住每个机会说英语。

basic.en: We are going to visit the museum on Saturday.
basic.cn: 我们周六要去参观博物馆。

basic.en: His handwriting is much better than mine.
basic.cn: 他的字比我的好得多。

basic.en: I put the keys on the table by the door.
basic.cn: 我把钥匙放在门边的桌子上。

basic.en: It is important to sleep for eight hours.
basic.cn: 睡足八小时很重要。

basic.en: The road was closed because of the heavy rain.
basic.cn: 因为大雨，道路封闭了。

basic.en: My father taught me how to ride a bike.
basic.cn: 我父亲教我骑自行车。

basic.en: She wants to be a doctor in the future.
basic.cn: 她将来想当医生。

basic.en: Do you mind if I open the window?
basic.cn: 你介意我开窗吗？

basic.en: This is the most interesting book I have read.
basic.cn: 这是我读过的最有趣的书。

basic.en: He answers the phone in a polite voice.
basic.cn: 他用礼貌的声音接电话。

basic.en: I am looking forward to hearing from you.
basic.cn: 我期待收到你的消息。

basic.en: They moved to a bigger house last year.
basic.cn: 他们去年搬进了更大的房子。

basic.en: The bus stop is just across the street.
basic.cn: 公交站就在街对面。

basic.en: Learning a language is like building a house.
basic.cn: 学一门语言就像盖房子。

basic.en: She kept smiling even when things were hard.
basic.cn: 即使事情很难，她也一直保持微笑。

basic.en: We need to buy some vegetables for dinner.
basic.cn: 我们需要买些蔬菜做晚饭。

basic.en: I did not understand the last question.
basic.cn: 我没听懂最后一个问题。

basic.en: He runs for half an hour every morning.
basic.cn: 他每天早上跑半小时。

basic.en: The lights went out during the storm.
basic.cn: 暴风雨中灯灭了。

basic.en: Practice brings progress, not perfection.
basic.cn: 练习带来的是进步，不是完美。

basic.en: I walk to school with my best friend every morning.
basic.cn: 我每天早上和我最好的朋友一起走路上学。

basic.en: She put her books on the desk and sat down.
basic.cn: 她把书放在桌上然后坐了下来。

basic.en: We are going to have a test next Tuesday.
basic.cn: 我们下周二有一次测验。

basic.en: My uncle is a driver and he works at night.
basic.cn: 我叔叔是司机，他上夜班。

basic.en: I cannot find my glasses anywhere.
basic.cn: 我到处都找不到我的眼镜。

basic.en: Please write your name at the top of the page.
basic.cn: 请把名字写在页面的顶端。

basic.en: He was late because his car broke down.
basic.cn: 他迟到是因为车坏了。

basic.en: The film starts at seven and ends at nine.
basic.cn: 电影七点开始，九点结束。

basic.en: I bought a new shirt for the job interview.
basic.cn: 我为面试买了一件新衬衫。

basic.en: She is the tallest girl in our class.
basic.cn: 她是我们班最高的女生。

basic.en: We often talk about our plans after class.
basic.cn: 我们下课后经常聊各自的计划。

basic.en: The old man walks in the park every evening.
basic.cn: 那位老人每天傍晚在公园散步。

basic.en: I have a lot of homework to do tonight.
basic.cn: 我今晚有很多作业要做。

basic.en: Do you want to come with us to the concert?
basic.cn: 你想和我们一起去音乐会吗？

basic.en: There were not many people in the shop.
basic.cn: 店里人不多。

basic.en: He put on his coat and went out quickly.
basic.cn: 他穿上外套很快就出去了。

basic.en: My new phone is much faster than the old one.
basic.cn: 我的新手机比旧手机快得多。

basic.en: The students are preparing for the final exam.
basic.cn: 学生们在为期末考试做准备。

basic.en: I am not sure whether the story is true.
basic.cn: 我不确定这个故事是不是真的。

basic.en: She left a message on the kitchen table.
basic.cn: 她在厨房的桌上留了张便条。

basic.en: We need to save money for the trip.
basic.cn: 我们需要为旅行存钱。

basic.en: The teacher explained the rule again and again.
basic.cn: 老师一遍又一遍地解释这条规则。

basic.en: It is not easy to change a habit.
basic.cn: 改变一个习惯不容易。

basic.en: My home is about three kilometres from here.
basic.cn: 我家离这里大约三公里。

basic.en: He is good at fixing small machines.
basic.cn: 他擅长修小机器。

basic.en: The children were excited about the school trip.
basic.cn: 孩子们对学校旅行很兴奋。

basic.en: I often listen to music while doing housework.
basic.cn: 我经常一边做家务一边听音乐。

basic.en: Could you speak a little more slowly, please?
basic.cn: 你能说得再慢一点吗？

basic.en: She has a very good memory for names.
basic.cn: 她对名字的记忆力很好。

basic.en: The room was warm and the light was soft.
basic.cn: 房间很暖和，灯光很柔和。

basic.en: We should not judge a person by his clothes.
basic.cn: 我们不该以衣着来评判一个人。

basic.en: He keeps a diary in English every day.
basic.cn: 他每天用英语写日记。

basic.en: My mother told me to take care of myself.
basic.cn: 妈妈让我照顾好自己。

basic.en: The small shop sells bread and milk.
basic.cn: 这家小店卖面包和牛奶。

basic.en: I will finish the work in about two hours.
basic.cn: 我大约两小时后完成这项工作。

basic.en: She was surprised to see me at the door.
basic.cn: 在门口看到我，她很惊讶。

basic.en: Learning new words takes time and patience.
basic.cn: 学新单词需要时间和耐心。

basic.en: The bus was crowded when I got on it.
basic.cn: 我上车时公交车很挤。

basic.en: He told me a funny story on the way home.
basic.cn: 回家路上他给我讲了个有趣的故事。

basic.en: I try to read one English article every day.
basic.cn: 我尽量每天读一篇英语文章。

basic.en: There is a bank next to the supermarket.
basic.cn: 超市旁边有一家银行。

basic.en: She washed her hands before eating lunch.
basic.cn: 她吃午饭前洗了手。

basic.en: We should turn off the lights when we leave.
basic.cn: 离开时我们应该关灯。

basic.en: My brother plays basketball every weekend.
basic.cn: 我哥哥每个周末打篮球。

basic.en: The letter arrived three days after it was sent.
basic.cn: 信寄出三天之后到了。

basic.en: I forgot to reply to his message.
basic.cn: 我忘了回他的消息。

basic.en: It is better to ask than to guess.
basic.cn: 问一下比瞎猜要好。

basic.en: She is busy preparing for the meeting.
basic.cn: 她正忙着准备会议。

basic.en: The teacher praised him for his hard work.
basic.cn: 老师表扬了他的努力。

basic.en: I like the way she explains difficult things.
basic.cn: 我喜欢她讲解难点的方式。

basic.en: We met each other at a friend's birthday party.
basic.cn: 我们是在一个朋友的生日聚会上认识的。

basic.en: He has lived in this city since two thousand and ten.
basic.cn: 他从二零一零年起就住在这个城市。

basic.en: The water in the lake looks very clean.
basic.cn: 湖里的水看起来很干净。

basic.en: Please tell me when you are free this week.
basic.cn: 请告诉我你这周什么时候有空。

basic.en: I was so tired that I fell asleep at once.
basic.cn: 我太累了，立刻就睡着了。

basic.en: The price is too high for a student like me.
basic.cn: 这个价格对我这样的学生来说太高了。

basic.en: She always keeps her promises.
basic.cn: 她总是信守承诺。

basic.en: Reading aloud helps you remember new words.
basic.cn: 朗读有助于你记住新单词。

basic.en: My computer is slow, so I will restart it.
basic.cn: 我的电脑很慢，我要重启一下。

basic.en: He does not like waiting in a long line.
basic.cn: 他不喜欢排长队等。

basic.en: The train was so full that I had to stand.
basic.cn: 火车太满了，我只能站着。

basic.en: I want to improve my listening and speaking.
basic.cn: 我想提高我的听力和口语。

basic.en: She put the flowers in a glass of water.
basic.cn: 她把花插在一杯水里。

basic.en: The weather report says it will be sunny tomorrow.
basic.cn: 天气预报说明天是晴天。

basic.en: We planted a small tree in the garden last spring.
basic.cn: 去年春天我们在花园里种了一棵小树。

basic.en: He is the only person who knows the answer.
basic.cn: 他是唯一知道答案的人。

basic.en: I cannot decide which one to choose.
basic.cn: 我决定不了该选哪一个。

basic.en: The meeting lasted for more than two hours.
basic.cn: 会议持续了两个多小时。

basic.en: She speaks three languages and is learning a fourth.
basic.cn: 她会说三种语言，还在学第四种。

basic.en: My friends came to see me when I was ill.
basic.cn: 我生病的时候朋友们来看我。

basic.en: It is important to keep your word.
basic.cn: 守信很重要。

basic.en: He found his wallet under the seat.
basic.cn: 他在座位下面找到了钱包。

basic.en: We should make a plan before we start.
basic.cn: 开始之前我们应该定个计划。

basic.en: The story is long, but it is very interesting.
basic.cn: 这个故事很长，但非常有趣。

basic.en: She did the work carefully and on time.
basic.cn: 她认真且准时地完成了工作。

basic.en: I go to the library once or twice a week.
basic.cn: 我一周去图书馆一两次。

basic.en: The noise outside stopped me from sleeping.
basic.cn: 外面的噪音让我睡不着。

basic.en: Practise your pronunciation for ten minutes a day.
basic.cn: 每天练十分钟发音。

basic.en: He learned to cook after he left home.
basic.cn: 他离开家之后学会了做饭。

basic.en: Small steps every day lead to big changes.
basic.cn: 每天一小步，最终带来大改变。

dialog.en: W: Excuse me, could you tell me where the nearest bank is? M: Sure. Go straight ahead and turn left at the second crossing. It's next to the post office.
dialog.cn: 女：打扰一下，你能告诉我最近的银行在哪里吗？男：当然。一直往前走，在第二个路口左转。就在邮局旁边。

dialog.en: M: What are you going to do this weekend? W: I plan to visit my grandparents in the countryside.
dialog.cn: 男：这个周末你打算做什么？女：我打算去乡下看望我的祖父母。

dialog.en: W: You look tired. Did you stay up late last night? M: Yes, I was preparing for the English exam.
dialog.cn: 女：你看起来很累。你昨晚熬夜了吗？男：是的，我在准备英语考试。

dialog.en: M: How much is this jacket? W: It's on sale today, only 150 yuan.
dialog.cn: 男：这件夹克多少钱？女：今天打折，只要 150 元。

dialog.en: W: Would you like to have dinner with us tonight? M: I'd love to, but I have to finish my report first.
dialog.cn: 女：你今晚愿意和我们一起吃饭吗？男：我很想，但我得先完成报告。

dialog.en: M: The meeting has been put off until Friday. W: That's fine. I need more time to prepare.
dialog.cn: 男：会议推迟到周五了。女：好的，我需要更多时间准备。

dialog.en: W: Have you heard about the new library? M: Yes, it opens next Monday and it's free for all students.
dialog.cn: 女：你听说过新图书馆吗？男：听说了，它下周一开始开放，对所有学生免费。

dialog.en: M: I can't find my keys anywhere. W: Did you check the pocket of your coat?
dialog.cn: 男：我到处都找不到钥匙。女：你检查过外套口袋吗？

dialog.en: W: What do you think of the movie we saw last night? M: Honestly, I found it a bit boring.
dialog.cn: 女：你觉得我们昨晚看的电影怎么样？男：说实话，我觉得有点无聊。

dialog.en: M: Excuse me, is this seat taken? W: No, please go ahead.
dialog.cn: 男：打扰一下，这个座位有人吗？女：没有，请坐。

dialog.en: W: How do you usually go to work? M: I take the subway. It's faster than driving.
dialog.cn: 女：你通常怎么去上班？男：我坐地铁，比开车快。

dialog.en: M: I heard you got a new job. Congratulations! W: Thank you. I start next month.
dialog.cn: 男：听说你找到了新工作。恭喜！女：谢谢，我下个月开始上班。

dialog.en: W: Could you help me carry these boxes upstairs? M: No problem. Let me take the heavy one.
dialog.cn: 女：你能帮我把这些箱子搬上楼吗？男：没问题，重的那个我来拿。

dialog.en: M: Do you prefer coffee or tea? W: Neither, actually. I usually drink water.
dialog.cn: 男：你更喜欢咖啡还是茶？女：其实都不喜欢，我通常喝水。

dialog.en: W: I'm afraid I can't finish the task by Friday. M: Don't worry. Take your time and do it well.
dialog.cn: 女：恐怕我周五前完不成这个任务。男：别担心，慢慢来，做好就行。

dialog.en: W: Excuse me, what time does the library close? M: At nine on weekdays, but at six on weekends.
dialog.cn: 女：打扰一下，图书馆几点关门？男：工作日九点，周末六点。

dialog.en: M: Would you like to join us for a walk after dinner? W: I'd love to, but I have to finish my report tonight.
dialog.cn: 男：晚饭后想和我们一起散步吗？女：我很想，但今晚得把报告写完。

dialog.en: W: How long does it take to get to the airport? M: About forty minutes by taxi if the traffic is good.
dialog.cn: 女：去机场要多久？男：如果交通顺畅，打车大约四十分钟。

dialog.en: M: I heard you moved to a new flat. How do you like it? W: It's much quieter, and the neighbours are friendly.
dialog.cn: 男：听说你搬了新公寓。感觉怎么样？女：安静多了，邻居也很友好。

dialog.en: W: Could you tell me where I can find a pharmacy? M: There's one around the corner, next to the bank.
dialog.cn: 女：你能告诉我哪里有药店吗？男：拐角处就有一家，在银行旁边。

dialog.en: M: You look worried. Is something wrong? W: I left my umbrella on the bus this morning.
dialog.cn: 男：你看起来很担心。出什么事了？女：我今早把伞落在公交车上了。

dialog.en: W: Would you like tea or coffee? M: Tea, please. I try not to drink coffee in the evening.
dialog.cn: 女：你想喝茶还是咖啡？男：茶，谢谢。我尽量晚上不喝咖啡。

dialog.en: M: What did you think of the speech yesterday? W: Honestly, it was too long and a little boring.
dialog.cn: 男：你觉得昨天的演讲怎么样？女：说实话，太长了，还有点无聊。

dialog.en: W: Do you know when the next train to Shanghai leaves? M: Let me check. It leaves at ten past three from platform four.
dialog.cn: 女：你知道下一班去上海的火车几点开吗？男：我查一下。三点十分从四号站台发车。

dialog.en: M: The printer is not working again. W: Did you try turning it off and then on?
dialog.cn: 男：打印机又坏了。女：你试过关机再开机吗？

dialog.en: W: I'm thinking of taking the bus instead of driving. M: Good idea. Parking downtown is really expensive.
dialog.cn: 女：我在考虑坐公交而不是开车。男：好主意。市中心停车真的很贵。

dialog.en: M: Have you finished reading the book I lent you? W: Not yet. I'm only on chapter three.
dialog.cn: 男：我借你的那本书看完了吗？女：还没，我才看到第三章。

dialog.en: W: What's the weather like in your hometown in spring? M: Warm and windy, with a lot of rain in April.
dialog.cn: 女：你家乡的春天天气怎么样？男：温暖多风，四月雨水很多。

dialog.en: M: My computer keeps shutting down by itself. W: You should have it checked. It might be overheating.
dialog.cn: 男：我的电脑老是自动关机。女：你该找人看看，可能是过热了。

dialog.en: W: Do you prefer working at home or in the office? M: At home, but I miss talking with my colleagues.
dialog.cn: 女：你更喜欢在家工作还是在办公室？男：在家，但我会想念和同事聊天。

dialog.en: M: I can't decide what to have for lunch. W: Why not try the new noodle place downstairs?
dialog.cn: 男：我决定不了午饭吃什么。女：何不试试楼下新开的面馆？

dialog.en: W: How often do you go to the gym? M: Twice a week, usually on Tuesday and Friday.
dialog.cn: 女：你多久去一次健身房？男：一周两次，通常周二和周五。

dialog.en: M: I'm sorry I'm late. The traffic was terrible. W: That's all right. The meeting hasn't started yet.
dialog.cn: 男：抱歉我迟到了，路上太堵。女：没关系，会议还没开始。

dialog.en: W: Should we book the tickets online? M: Yes, it's cheaper and we can choose our seats.
dialog.cn: 女：我们应该在网上订票吗？男：对，便宜一些，还能选座位。

dialog.en: M: Do you know how to fix this broken chair? W: I'm afraid you'd better buy a new one.
dialog.cn: 男：你知道怎么修这把坏椅子吗？女：恐怕你最好买把新的。

dialog.en: W: I've been feeling tired all week. M: Maybe you should go to bed earlier.
dialog.cn: 女：我这周一直觉得累。男：也许你该早点睡。

dialog.en: M: What time should we meet tomorrow morning? W: Let's meet at the school gate at half past seven.
dialog.cn: 男：我们明天早上几点见？女：七点半在校门口见吧。

dialog.en: W: Is this seat free? M: Yes, please sit down. The train is quite empty today.
dialog.cn: 女：这个座位空着吗？男：空着，请坐。今天火车挺空的。

dialog.en: M: I'd like to return this shirt. It's too small. W: Of course. Do you have the receipt with you?
dialog.cn: 男：我想退这件衬衫，太小了。女：当然可以。你带收据了吗？

dialog.en: W: Your English has improved a lot. M: Thanks. I've been practising every morning.
dialog.cn: 女：你的英语进步很大。男：谢谢，我每天早上都在练。

dialog.en: M: Do you think it will rain this afternoon? W: The sky looks dark, so take an umbrella.
dialog.cn: 男：你觉得今天下午会下雨吗？女：天看起来很暗，带把伞吧。

dialog.en: W: How was your weekend? M: Busy. I helped my parents clean the house.
dialog.cn: 女：周末过得怎么样？男：很忙，我帮父母打扫了房子。

dialog.en: M: Can you turn down the TV a bit? W: Sorry, I didn't know it was too loud.
dialog.cn: 男：你能把电视关小一点吗？女：抱歉，我不知道声音太大了。

dialog.en: W: Do you know a good place to buy shoes? M: There's a shop on Main Street with fair prices.
dialog.cn: 女：你知道哪里买鞋好吗？男：主街上有一家店，价格公道。

dialog.en: M: I've lost my student card again. W: You really should keep it in a safe place.
dialog.cn: 男：我又把学生证弄丢了。女：你真该把它放在安全的地方。

dialog.en: W: Would you mind closing the door? M: Not at all. It's a bit noisy outside.
dialog.cn: 女：你介意把门关上吗？男：完全不介意，外面有点吵。

dialog.en: M: How much is the rent for this flat? W: Two thousand a month, including water and electricity.
dialog.cn: 男：这套公寓的租金多少？女：每月两千，含水电。

dialog.en: W: I'm not sure I can finish the report by Friday. M: Why not ask for two more days?
dialog.cn: 女：我不确定周五前能写完报告。男：为什么不申请多两天？

dialog.en: M: Did you enjoy the film last night? W: The music was lovely, but the story was weak.
dialog.cn: 男：你昨晚那部电影看得开心吗？女：音乐很好，但故事单薄。

dialog.en: W: Excuse me, is there a cafe near here? M: Yes, just opposite the bookshop, on your left.
dialog.cn: 女：打扰一下，这附近有咖啡馆吗？男：有，就在书店对面，你左手边。

dialog.en: M: You have a lot of books. Do you read them all? W: Not all of them, but I read a little every day.
dialog.cn: 男：你书真多。你都读完了吗？女：不是全部，但我每天都读一点。

dialog.en: W: Shall we take a break? We've worked for two hours. M: Good idea. Let's get some water first.
dialog.cn: 女：我们休息一下好吗？已经工作两小时了。男：好主意，先去喝点水。

dialog.en: M: I'm afraid the shop is closed on Mondays. W: Then let's come back tomorrow afternoon.
dialog.cn: 男：恐怕这家店周一休息。女：那我们明天下午再来吧。

dialog.en: W: How did you learn to type so fast? M: I practised online for twenty minutes a day.
dialog.cn: 女：你怎么把打字练得这么快的？男：我每天在网上练二十分钟。

dialog.en: M: Do you want to share a taxi to the station? W: Sure, that will save both of us some money.
dialog.cn: 男：要不要一起打车去车站？女：好啊，这样我们都能省点钱。

dialog.en: W: My phone has no signal in this building. M: Mine too. Let's go outside to make the call.
dialog.cn: 女：这栋楼里我手机没信号。男：我的也是，我们出去打吧。

dialog.en: M: I think I left my keys in the classroom. W: Don't worry. Let's go back and look.
dialog.cn: 男：我想我把钥匙落在教室了。女：别急，我们回去找找。

dialog.en: W: This coffee tastes a bit strange. M: I think they put too much sugar in it.
dialog.cn: 女：这咖啡味道有点怪。男：我想是他们糖放多了。

dialog.en: M: Are you going home for the holiday? W: No, I'll stay here and study for the exam.
dialog.cn: 男：假期你回家吗？女：不回，我留在这儿准备考试。

dialog.en: W: Could you repeat the last sentence, please? M: Certainly. I said the office closes at five.
dialog.cn: 女：请你重复最后一句好吗？男：当然。我说办公室五点关门。

dialog.en: M: I've never seen such a long queue here. W: It's because of the sale. Everything is half price.
dialog.cn: 男：我从没见过这里排这么长的队。女：因为大促销，所有东西半价。

dialog.en: W: What do you usually do on Sunday mornings? M: I sleep late and then go for a run.
dialog.cn: 女：你周日上午通常做什么？男：睡个懒觉，然后去跑步。

dialog.en: M: My sister wants to borrow my camera. W: That's fine, as long as she takes good care of it.
dialog.cn: 男：我妹妹想借我的相机。女：可以啊，只要她好好爱惜。

dialog.en: W: Do you know if the museum is open today? M: It's closed on public holidays, I'm afraid.
dialog.cn: 女：你知道博物馆今天开门吗？男：恐怕公共假日是关门的。

dialog.en: M: I'm getting fat. I should eat less meat. W: And you should also exercise more often.
dialog.cn: 男：我胖了，应该少吃点肉。女：而且你也该多运动。

dialog.en: W: Which do you like better, spring or autumn? M: Autumn. It's cool and the colours are beautiful.
dialog.cn: 女：你更喜欢春天还是秋天？男：秋天。凉爽，颜色也美。

dialog.en: M: Could I have the bill, please? W: Certainly, sir. Would you like to pay by card?
dialog.cn: 男：请给我账单好吗？女：好的，先生。您要刷卡吗？

dialog.en: W: I hear you're learning Chinese. How is it going? M: Slowly. The characters are the hardest part.
dialog.cn: 女：听说你在学中文，进展如何？男：很慢，汉字是最难的部分。

dialog.en: M: Let's meet at the restaurant at six thirty. W: Make it seven. I have a class until six.
dialog.cn: 男：我们六点半在餐厅见吧。女：改七点吧，我六点前有课。

dialog.en: W: My bike has a flat tyre again. M: You can borrow mine. I'm not using it today.
dialog.cn: 女：我的自行车又爆胎了。男：我的借你用，我今天不用。

dialog.en: M: Did you remember to lock the door? W: Yes, I checked it twice before we left.
dialog.cn: 男：你记得锁门了吗？女：记得，走之前我检查了两遍。

dialog.en: W: I can't find the file you sent me. M: Try searching for the title in your mail box.
dialog.cn: 女：我找不到你发给我的文件。男：试试在邮箱里搜标题。

dialog.en: M: The soup is a little too salty for me. W: Sorry. I'll ask them to change it for you.
dialog.cn: 男：这汤对我来说有点太咸了。女：抱歉，我让他们给你换一份。

dialog.en: W: How long have you been waiting here? M: About twenty minutes. The bus must be late.
dialog.cn: 女：你在这儿等多久了？男：大约二十分钟。公交肯定晚点了。

dialog.en: M: Do you want to see a doctor about that cough? W: I will if it doesn't get better in two days.
dialog.cn: 男：你要不要去看看咳嗽？女：如果两天内不见好我就去。

dialog.en: W: I'm looking for a part time job this term. M: The bookshop near the gate is hiring students.
dialog.cn: 女：这学期我想找份兼职。男：门口那家书店在招学生。

dialog.en: M: What time does your first class start? W: At eight, so I have to get up at six thirty.
dialog.cn: 男：你第一节课几点开始？女：八点，所以我六点半就得起床。

dialog.en: W: This dictionary is really useful for my study. M: I'm glad you like it. It was a birthday gift.
dialog.cn: 女：这本词典对我学习真有用。男：你喜欢就好，那是生日礼物。

dialog.en: M: Shall I open the window? The room feels stuffy. W: Please do. Some fresh air will help.
dialog.cn: 男：我开窗好吗？房间有点闷。女：开吧，透点新鲜空气好。

dialog.en: W: My parents want me to study medicine. M: But you'd rather study history, wouldn't you?
dialog.cn: 女：我父母想让我学医。男：但你更想学历史，对吧？

dialog.en: M: How was the interview? W: I was nervous, but I think I answered well.
dialog.cn: 男：面试怎么样？女：我很紧张，但我觉得答得不错。

dialog.en: W: I've bought two tickets for the concert. M: Great. Who are you going with?
dialog.cn: 女：我买了两张音乐会的票。男：太好了。你和谁去？

dialog.en: M: Could you show me how to use this machine? W: Sure. First, press this green button.
dialog.cn: 男：你能教我怎么用这台机器吗？女：当然。先按这个绿色的按钮。

dialog.en: W: I can't believe the term is almost over. M: Neither can I. The time has really flown.
dialog.cn: 女：真不敢相信这学期快结束了。男：我也是，时间过得真快。

dialog.en: M: Let's take the subway. It's faster than the bus. W: But it's more crowded at this hour.
dialog.cn: 男：我们坐地铁吧，比公交快。女：但这个点地铁更挤。

dialog.en: W: Do you know where I can print my paper? M: The library has printers on the second floor.
dialog.cn: 女：你知道我在哪儿能打印论文吗？男：图书馆二楼有打印机。

dialog.en: M: I'd like to book a table for four at seven. W: I'm sorry, but we're fully booked until eight.
dialog.cn: 男：我想订七点四个人的桌。女：抱歉，八点前都订满了。

dialog.en: W: My new neighbour plays music late at night. M: Have you tried talking to him about it?
dialog.cn: 女：我的新邻居深夜放音乐。男：你试着跟他说过吗？

dialog.en: M: What's the best way to remember new words? W: Use them in sentences you write yourself.
dialog.cn: 男：记新单词最好的办法是什么？女：把它们用在你自己写的句子里。

dialog.en: W: I think I left my umbrella in your car. M: Let me check. Yes, it's on the back seat.
dialog.cn: 女：我想我把伞落在你车上了。男：我看看。对，在后座上。

dialog.en: M: The meeting room is on the third floor, isn't it? W: It was moved to the fifth floor this morning.
dialog.cn: 男：会议室在三楼，对吧？女：今天早上改到五楼了。

dialog.en: W: Do you mind if I turn on the light? M: Go ahead. It is getting dark in here.
dialog.cn: 女：我开灯你介意吗？男：开吧，这里越来越暗了。

dialog.en: M: I'm thinking about buying a used car. W: Be careful. Ask a friend to check it first.
dialog.cn: 男：我在考虑买辆二手车。女：小心点，先找个朋友帮你验车。

dialog.en: W: How do you keep in touch with your old friends? M: We chat online and meet once a year.
dialog.cn: 女：你怎么和老朋友保持联系？男：我们在网上聊，每年见一次。

dialog.en: M: I'm sorry, but I have to leave early today. W: That's fine. I'll take notes for you.
dialog.cn: 男：抱歉，我今天得早点走。女：没事，我帮你记笔记。

dialog.en: W: This exercise is harder than the last one. M: Take your time. There's no need to hurry.
dialog.cn: 女：这道题比上一道难。男：慢慢来，不用急。

dialog.en: M: Have you decided which course to take? W: Not yet. I'll talk to my teacher tomorrow.
dialog.cn: 男：你决定选哪门课了吗？女：还没，我明天和老师谈谈。

dialog.en: W: The train leaves in ten minutes. Let's hurry. M: Wait, I need to buy a bottle of water first.
dialog.cn: 女：火车十分钟后开，我们快点。男：等等，我先买瓶水。

dialog.en: M: Your room looks much tidier than before. W: I spent the whole morning cleaning it.
dialog.cn: 男：你的房间比以前整洁多了。女：我打扫了一上午。

dialog.en: W: Do you think I should take the job? M: It depends on whether you like the city.
dialog.cn: 女：你觉得我该接这份工作吗？男：这取决于你喜不喜欢那座城市。

dialog.en: M: Did you watch the game last night? W: Only the second half. I had to finish my homework first.
dialog.cn: 男：你昨晚看比赛了吗？女：只看了下半场。我得先把作业做完。

dialog.en: W: I'm afraid I've broken your cup. M: Don't worry about it. It wasn't expensive.
dialog.cn: 女：恐怕我把你的杯子打碎了。男：别放在心上，那杯子不贵。

dialog.en: M: How do you get to work every day? W: I cycle when the weather is fine.
dialog.cn: 男：你每天怎么去上班？女：天气好的时候我骑车。

dialog.en: W: Would you like me to help you carry those bags? M: That would be great. They're heavier than they look.
dialog.cn: 女：要我帮你提那些袋子吗？男：那太好了。它们比看上去重。

dialog.en: M: Is it far from here to the city centre? W: About fifteen minutes on foot.
dialog.cn: 男：从这里到市中心远吗？女：走路大约十五分钟。

dialog.en: W: My son refuses to eat vegetables. M: Try cutting them into small pieces.
dialog.cn: 女：我儿子不肯吃蔬菜。男：试试把它们切成小块。

dialog.en: M: What time does the shop open on Sunday? W: I think it opens at ten, but let me check.
dialog.cn: 男：这家店周日几点开门？女：我想是十点，我再确认一下。

dialog.en: W: You've been very quiet today. Are you all right? M: Just tired. I didn't sleep well.
dialog.cn: 女：你今天很安静。你还好吗？男：只是累了，我没睡好。

dialog.en: M: Can I pay by phone? W: I'm sorry, we only take cash or cards.
dialog.cn: 男：我可以手机支付吗？女：抱歉，我们只收现金或刷卡。

dialog.en: W: How much does a ticket to the museum cost? M: Twenty yuan for students, forty for adults.
dialog.cn: 女：博物馆门票多少钱？男：学生二十元，成人四十元。

dialog.en: M: I'm going to be away for a week. W: Don't worry. I'll water your plants.
dialog.cn: 男：我要离开一周。女：别担心，我会给你的花浇水。

dialog.en: W: Did the teacher say anything about the deadline? M: She moved it to next Monday.
dialog.cn: 女：老师说截止日期的事了吗？男：她把期限改到下周一了。

dialog.en: M: I really like your jacket. Where did you get it? W: My sister gave it to me last winter.
dialog.cn: 男：我很喜欢你这件外套。在哪儿买的？女：去年冬天我姐姐送我的。

dialog.en: W: What should I wear to the party? M: Something comfortable. It's a very informal one.
dialog.cn: 女：我应该穿什么去聚会？男：舒服一点就行，那是个很随意的聚会。

dialog.en: M: My internet is very slow tonight. W: Mine too. It may be a problem in the area.
dialog.cn: 男：我今晚网速很慢。女：我的也是，可能是这一片的问题。

dialog.en: W: Have you booked your flight yet? M: Not yet. The prices are still too high.
dialog.cn: 女：你订机票了吗？男：还没，价格还是太高。

dialog.en: M: Could you give me a hand with these boxes? W: Of course. Where should I put them?
dialog.cn: 男：你能帮我搬这些箱子吗？女：当然。我该放哪儿？

dialog.en: W: How did you find this restaurant? M: A friend recommended it, and I've come back ever since.
dialog.cn: 女：你怎么找到这家餐馆的？男：一个朋友推荐的，从那以后我就常来。

dialog.en: M: I've been invited to a wedding next month. W: That's nice. Do you know the couple well?
dialog.cn: 男：下个月有人请我参加婚礼。女：真好。你和新郎新娘熟吗？

dialog.en: W: Is this the right bus for the train station? M: No, you need the number fifteen.
dialog.cn: 女：这趟公交到火车站吗？男：不到，你要坐十五路。

dialog.en: M: I can't believe how much it costs to park here. W: That's why I always take the bus.
dialog.cn: 男：真不敢相信这里停车这么贵。女：所以我一向坐公交。

dialog.en: W: Do you have any plans for the summer? M: I'm hoping to visit my grandparents.
dialog.cn: 女：暑假有什么打算吗？男：我希望能去看看我的祖父母。

dialog.en: M: The soup needs a little more salt. W: Really? I thought it was fine.
dialog.cn: 男：这汤还需要加点盐。女：真的吗？我觉得刚好。

dialog.en: W: My sister is coming to stay with me next week. M: How long is she staying?
dialog.cn: 女：我妹妹下周要来我这儿住。男：她住多久？

dialog.en: M: Did you get my message yesterday? W: Sorry, my phone was out of power.
dialog.cn: 男：你昨天收到我的消息了吗？女：抱歉，我手机没电了。

dialog.en: W: I'd like to open a bank account, please. M: Certainly. Do you have your ID with you?
dialog.cn: 女：我想开一个银行账户。男：好的。你带身份证了吗？

dialog.en: M: This shirt fits well, but I don't like the colour. W: We have it in blue and grey as well.
dialog.cn: 男：这件衬衫合身，但我不喜欢这个颜色。女：我们还有蓝色和灰色的。

dialog.en: W: How long will the repair take? M: About three days if we can get the parts.
dialog.cn: 女：修理要多久？男：如果能拿到配件，大约三天。

dialog.en: M: Shall I call you a taxi? W: No thanks, I'll walk. It's not far.
dialog.cn: 男：要我帮你叫辆出租车吗？女：不用了，我走过去，不远。

dialog.en: W: The train was delayed for almost an hour. M: That explains why you're so late.
dialog.cn: 女：火车晚点了将近一小时。男：难怪你来得这么晚。

dialog.en: M: Are you free on Friday evening? W: I'm afraid I have a class then.
dialog.cn: 男：你周五晚上有空吗？女：恐怕那时我有课。

dialog.en: W: I don't understand this word. Could you explain it? M: It means to make something better.
dialog.cn: 女：我不懂这个词。你能解释一下吗？男：它的意思是把某物变得更好。

dialog.en: M: You look different today. Did you change your hair? W: Yes, I had it cut short.
dialog.cn: 男：你今天看起来不一样。剪头发了？女：是的，我剪短了。

dialog.en: W: What did you do when the power went off? M: I lit a candle and read a book.
dialog.cn: 女：停电的时候你做了什么？男：我点了蜡烛看书。

dialog.en: M: Can I bring a friend to the dinner? W: Of course. Let me know how many people.
dialog.cn: 男：我能带个朋友来参加晚宴吗？女：当然。告诉我一共几个人。

dialog.en: W: I've been trying to give up coffee. M: How is it going so far?
dialog.cn: 女：我一直在努力戒咖啡。男：目前进展怎么样？

dialog.en: M: Where did you learn to swim? W: My father taught me when I was six.
dialog.cn: 男：你在哪儿学的游泳？女：我六岁时父亲教我的。

dialog.en: W: Is the library open during the holidays? M: Only in the morning, from nine to twelve.
dialog.cn: 女：假期图书馆开门吗？男：只有上午，九点到十二点。

dialog.en: M: I think I'll take the early train tomorrow. W: Then you'd better set an alarm.
dialog.cn: 男：我想明天坐早班火车。女：那你最好定个闹钟。

dialog.en: W: How was your first day at work? M: A bit confusing, but everyone was helpful.
dialog.cn: 女：你上班第一天怎么样？男：有点手忙脚乱，但大家都很帮忙。

dialog.en: M: My watch has stopped. What time is it? W: It's twenty past four by my phone.
dialog.cn: 男：我的表停了。现在几点？女：我手机上显示四点二十。

dialog.en: W: I'd like to exchange this book for another one. M: Sure. Just bring the receipt next time.
dialog.cn: 女：我想把这本书换一本。男：好的，下次带上收据就行。

dialog.en: M: Did you find everything you needed? W: Almost. I couldn't find the milk.
dialog.cn: 男：你需要的东西都找到了吗？女：差不多，就是没找到牛奶。

dialog.en: W: Do you think we should leave now? M: Yes, the roads get busy after five.
dialog.cn: 女：你觉得我们现在该走了吗？男：嗯，五点以后路上会堵。

dialog.en: M: I've never been to a concert before. W: Then you're in for a lovely evening.
dialog.cn: 男：我从没去过音乐会。女：那你今晚会过得很愉快。

dialog.en: W: How often does the bus come? M: Every fifteen minutes during the day.
dialog.cn: 女：公交多久一班？男：白天十五分钟一班。

dialog.en: M: This room is very cold. Is the heating on? W: I'll ask the front desk about it.
dialog.cn: 男：这房间很冷。暖气开了吗？女：我去问问前台。

dialog.en: W: I'm not sure this is the right way. M: Let's ask someone to be sure.
dialog.cn: 女：我不确定这条路对不对。男：我们问一下人确认吧。

dialog.en: M: Do you want to join us for dinner? W: I'd like to, but I've already eaten.
dialog.cn: 男：你想和我们一起吃晚饭吗？女：我很想，但我已经吃过了。

dialog.en: W: My flight leaves at six in the morning. M: You'll need to leave home very early.
dialog.cn: 女：我的航班早上六点起飞。男：那你得很早就出门。

dialog.en: M: Can you help me move the table? W: Sure, but let's take the things off it first.
dialog.cn: 男：你能帮我搬一下桌子吗？女：可以，不过先把上面的东西拿下来。

dialog.en: W: Where can I find the history section? M: On the top floor, near the windows.
dialog.cn: 女：历史类书籍在哪儿？男：在顶楼，靠窗那边。

dialog.en: M: I heard the shop is closing down. W: Really? I've been going there for years.
dialog.cn: 男：听说那家店要关门了。女：真的吗？我光顾好多年了。

dialog.en: W: What's your favourite subject at school? M: English, because I like the teacher.
dialog.cn: 女：你在学校最喜欢哪一科？男：英语，因为我喜欢那位老师。

dialog.en: M: I've lost the address you gave me. W: Let me send it to you again.
dialog.cn: 男：我把你给我的地址弄丢了。女：我再发给你一次。

dialog.en: W: Do you know how to get to the park? M: Go straight and turn right at the lights.
dialog.cn: 女：你知道怎么去公园吗？男：一直走，到红绿灯右转。

dialog.en: M: The film lasts two and a half hours. W: That's longer than I expected.
dialog.cn: 男：这部电影两个半小时。女：比我预想的长。

dialog.en: W: Can I try these shoes in a smaller size? M: Of course. What size do you need?
dialog.cn: 女：这双鞋我能试试小一号的吗？男：当然。您要多大码？

dialog.en: M: I think I've caught a cold. W: You should drink something warm and rest.
dialog.cn: 男：我想我感冒了。女：你该喝点热的，然后休息一下。

dialog.en: W: When is the best time to visit your city? M: Late autumn. The weather is perfect then.
dialog.cn: 女：什么时候去你们城市最好？男：深秋。那时候天气最好。

dialog.en: M: My parents are coming to visit next weekend. W: Are you going to cook for them?
dialog.cn: 男：我父母下周末来看我。女：你打算给他们做饭吗？

dialog.en: W: I've decided to study abroad next year. M: That's exciting. Which country?
dialog.cn: 女：我决定明年出国留学。男：真让人兴奋。去哪个国家？

dialog.en: M: The bill seems higher than usual. W: We ordered two more dishes, remember?
dialog.cn: 男：账单好像比平时高。女：我们多点两个菜，记得吗？

dialog.en: W: Do you know anyone who can fix a bike? M: My neighbour does it for a small fee.
dialog.cn: 女：你认识会修自行车的人吗？男：我邻居修，收费很少。

dialog.en: M: I'm afraid I can't come to your party. W: That's a pity. Maybe next time.
dialog.cn: 男：恐怕我去不了你的聚会。女：真可惜，下次吧。

dialog.en: W: How did the meeting go this morning? M: Well, but it took much longer than planned.
dialog.cn: 女：今天上午的会开得怎么样？男：还行，就是比计划长了很多。

dialog.en: M: Would you like a window seat or an aisle? W: A window, please. I like the view.
dialog.cn: 男：您要靠窗还是靠过道？女：靠窗，谢谢。我喜欢看风景。

dialog.en: W: I can't get used to the food here. M: Give it time. You'll get used to it.
dialog.cn: 女：我吃不惯这里的饭菜。男：慢慢来，你会习惯的。

dialog.en: M: Is it all right if I leave my bag here? W: Sure, nobody will touch it.
dialog.cn: 男：我把包放这儿行吗？女：可以，没人会动它。

dialog.en: W: My computer needs a new battery. M: Have you checked the price online?
dialog.cn: 女：我的电脑需要换块新电池。男：你在网上查过价格吗？

dialog.en: M: Do you know why the class was cancelled? W: The teacher had an important meeting.
dialog.cn: 男：你知道课为什么取消了吗？女：老师有个重要会议。

dialog.en: W: I'd like to pay for these two books. M: That will be fifty yuan altogether.
dialog.cn: 女：我想付这两本书的钱。男：一共五十元。

dialog.en: M: How long have you lived in this neighbourhood? W: Almost ten years now.
dialog.cn: 男：你在这个小区住多久了？女：到现在快十年了。

dialog.en: W: I'm looking for a gift for my mother. M: What does she usually like?
dialog.cn: 女：我想给我妈妈挑个礼物。男：她平时喜欢什么？

dialog.en: M: The water in the tap is not very clean. W: They said it will be fixed by tomorrow.
dialog.cn: 男：水龙头的水不太干净。女：他们说明天就能修好。

dialog.en: W: Did you manage to finish the project? M: Just barely. I worked till midnight.
dialog.cn: 女：你的项目完成了吗？男：勉强完成了，我干到半夜。

dialog.en: M: Could you keep an eye on my things? W: No problem. Take your time.
dialog.cn: 男：你能帮我看一下东西吗？女：没问题，你慢慢来。

dialog.en: W: I'd like to change my appointment to Thursday. M: Let me check the schedule for you.
dialog.cn: 女：我想把预约改到周四。男：我帮你查一下日程。

dialog.en: M: Is it going to be cold tonight? W: Yes, so take an extra blanket.
dialog.cn: 男：今晚会冷吗？女：会，所以多带一条毯子。

dialog.en: W: Thanks for helping me today. M: My pleasure. Call me if you need anything.
dialog.cn: 女：谢谢你今天帮我。男：不客气。需要什么就给我打电话。

passage.en: Welcome to the school library. It is open from eight in the morning until ten at night. Please keep your voice down and put your phone on silent.
passage.cn: 欢迎来到学校图书馆。开放时间是早上八点到晚上十点。请保持安静，并把手机调成静音。

passage.en: The English corner will meet on Wednesday afternoon. It starts at four in room three hundred and five. Everyone is welcome to join.
passage.cn: 英语角将在周三下午举行。四点在三百零五教室开始。欢迎大家参加。

passage.en: Our school will hold a sports meeting next Friday. Students who want to take part should sign their names this week. The winners will get small prizes.
passage.cn: 我们学校下周五举行运动会。想参加的同学这周报名。获奖者会得到小奖品。

passage.en: The reading room is closed for cleaning this morning. It will open again at two in the afternoon. Sorry for the trouble.
passage.cn: 阅览室今天上午因打扫卫生关闭。下午两点会重新开放。给您带来不便，敬请谅解。

passage.en: A new course on public speaking starts next month. It is free for all students. Please register at the office before Friday.
passage.cn: 一门关于公开演讲的新课程下个月开课。对所有学生免费。请在周五前到办公室报名。

passage.en: The final exam will be held in the main hall. Please bring your student card and a black pen. Mobile phones are not allowed.
passage.cn: 期末考试将在主礼堂举行。请携带学生证和黑色签字笔。不允许携带手机。

passage.en: The school bus leaves at seven sharp every morning. It stops at three places on the way. Do not be late, as it will not wait.
passage.cn: 校车每天早上七点整出发。沿途停三个站。不要迟到，车不会等人。

passage.en: Our teacher asked us to hand in the report on Monday. Late reports will lose some marks. If you have problems, talk to her early.
passage.cn: 老师要求我们周一交报告。迟交会扣分。如果有困难，早点跟她说。

passage.en: There will be a talk about studying abroad this evening. The speaker is a former student of our school. It starts at seven in the lecture hall.
passage.cn: 今晚有一场关于出国留学的讲座。主讲人是我校的一位校友。七点在报告厅开始。

passage.en: The computer room has twenty new machines. They are faster and quieter than the old ones. Students can use them after class.
passage.cn: 机房有二十台新电脑。比旧机器更快也更安静。学生下课后可以使用。

passage.en: Tomorrow will be cloudy in the morning and sunny in the afternoon. The temperature will be between ten and eighteen degrees. Light rain is expected at night.
passage.cn: 明天上午多云，下午晴。气温在十到十八度之间。夜间预计有小雨。

passage.en: Spring comes early in the south of the country. Trees turn green in February and flowers open in March. Visitors come to see them from all over.
passage.cn: 这个国家的南方春天来得早。二月树就变绿，三月花就开了。各地游客都来观赏。

passage.en: It rained heavily for three days last week. Many roads in the low areas were under water. The city sent workers to help the people there.
passage.cn: 上周连下了三天大雨。低洼地区的许多道路被水淹了。市里派了工作人员去帮助那里的人。

passage.en: Winter here is cold and dry. The temperature often falls below zero at night. Remember to wear a hat and gloves when you go out.
passage.cn: 这里的冬天又冷又干。夜里气温常常降到零度以下。出门记得戴帽子和手套。

passage.en: The weather report says a strong wind is coming. Please close all the windows before you leave home. Small boats should stay in the harbour.
passage.cn: 天气预报说有大风要来。出门前请关好所有窗户。小船应该留在港口里。

passage.en: Autumn is the best season for walking in the mountains. The air is cool and the leaves are red and gold. Take a warm coat for the evening.
passage.cn: 秋天是进山徒步最好的季节。空气凉爽，树叶红黄相间。晚上要带件厚外套。

passage.en: The summer here is hot and wet. It rains almost every afternoon. People usually stay indoors between twelve and three.
passage.cn: 这里的夏天又热又潮。几乎每天下午都下雨。人们中午十二点到三点通常待在室内。

passage.en: A snowstorm hit the north of the country last night. Many flights were delayed and some roads were closed. Schools in the area are closed today.
passage.cn: 昨晚一场暴风雪袭击了这个国家的北部。许多航班延误，部分道路封闭。该地区的学校今天停课。

passage.en: It is a good idea to check the weather before a trip. A small umbrella does not take much space. A light jacket can also be very useful.
passage.cn: 出行前查一下天气是个好主意。一把小伞不占什么地方。一件薄外套也很有用。

passage.en: The days are getting shorter and shorter. It gets dark before six in the evening now. People go home earlier than they did in summer.
passage.cn: 白天越来越短了。现在傍晚六点前就天黑。人们比夏天时更早回家。

passage.en: Many students find it hard to keep a study plan. The problem is usually not time but habit. Try to study at the same hour every day, even for ten minutes.
passage.cn: 很多学生觉得坚持学习计划很难。问题通常不是时间不够，而是习惯没建立。试着每天在同一时间学习，哪怕只有十分钟。

passage.en: If you study for too long without a break, your memory gets worse. Stand up and walk around every forty minutes. A short rest helps your brain store what you have learned.
passage.cn: 如果长时间学习不休息，记忆力反而会变差。每四十分钟站起来走一走。短暂休息有助于大脑把学到的东西存下来。

passage.en: Reading English news is a good way to learn new words. Do not look up every word you do not know. Try to guess the meaning from the sentence first.
passage.cn: 读英语新闻是学新单词的好方法。不要每个不认识的词都去查。先试着从句子猜意思。

passage.en: Do not try to remember a hundred new words in one day. You will forget most of them by the next morning. Fifteen words a day is a better plan.
passage.cn: 不要试图一天记住一百个新词。到第二天早上你会忘掉大部分。每天十五个是更好的计划。

passage.en: Speaking a language is a skill, not a subject. You cannot learn it only by reading about it. You have to open your mouth and make mistakes.
passage.cn: 说一门语言是技能，不是学科。只靠读是学不会的。你必须开口，并且允许自己犯错。

passage.en: A good way to remember a word is to use it in your own sentence. The sentence does not have to be clever. It only has to be about your own life.
passage.cn: 记住一个词的好办法是把它用在你自己造的句子里。句子不必巧妙，只要和你的生活有关就行。

passage.en: Reviewing what you learned yesterday is more useful than learning something new. Spend ten minutes going over old words before you start. It makes the new lesson easier.
passage.cn: 复习昨天学过的比学新东西更有用。开始前花十分钟过一遍旧词，新课文会变得更容易。

passage.en: Write down the words you keep forgetting in a small notebook. Look at the list before you go to bed. Your brain works on it while you sleep.
passage.cn: 把总记不住的词写在小本子上。睡前看一眼这个清单。你睡觉时大脑还在处理它。

passage.en: Listening is the hardest part for most learners. Start with short and slow materials. Then make them longer and faster, a little at a time.
passage.cn: 对大多数学习者来说听力是最难的部分。从简短、慢速的材料开始。然后一点点加长、加快。

passage.en: Do not be afraid of making mistakes in front of others. Every mistake you notice is one you will not make again. The people who speak well are the ones who spoke badly first.
passage.cn: 不要害怕在别人面前出错。每一个被你注意到的错误，你下次都不会再犯。说得好的人，都是从说得差开始的。

passage.en: Our city has a history of more than two thousand years. It is famous for its old bridges and small rivers. Every spring, thousands of visitors come to walk along the water.
passage.cn: 我们这座城市有两千多年的历史。以古桥和小河闻名。每年春天，成千上万的游客沿水边漫步。

passage.en: The train from Beijing to Shanghai takes about four and a half hours. Trains leave every thirty minutes during the day. It is better to book your ticket online.
passage.cn: 从北京到上海的火车大约要四个半小时。白天每三十分钟一班。最好在网上订票。

passage.en: If you visit the old town, wear comfortable shoes. The streets are narrow and made of stone. Cars are not allowed inside.
passage.cn: 如果你去老城区，穿双舒服的鞋。街道狭窄，是石板铺的。里面不允许汽车通行。

passage.en: The museum is free on the first Sunday of every month. You still need to book a ticket in advance. The most popular room is the one with the ancient paintings.
passage.cn: 博物馆每月第一个周日免费。但仍需提前订票。最受欢迎的展厅是陈列古画的那间。

passage.en: There is a small fishing village two hours from the city. The seafood there is fresh and cheap. Most visitors go there for a quiet weekend.
passage.cn: 离城里两小时车程有个小渔村。那里的海鲜又新鲜又便宜。大多数游客去那儿过一个安静的周末。

passage.en: The airport is about forty kilometres from the city centre. A taxi takes about fifty minutes. A bus is cheaper but takes twice as long.
passage.cn: 机场离市中心约四十公里。打车大约五十分钟。公交便宜些，但要多花一倍时间。

passage.en: Many travellers now choose to stay in small guest houses. They are cheaper than hotels and often more interesting. The owners usually give good advice about the area.
passage.cn: 现在很多旅行者选择住小民宿。比酒店便宜，而且往往更有意思。老板通常能给出当地的好建议。

passage.en: The best way to see the old city is on foot. Walking lets you turn into small streets. That is where the real life of the city is.
passage.cn: 看老城最好的方式是步行。走路才能拐进小巷。城市真正的生活就在那里。

passage.en: Our town holds a food festival every October. Local families cook their best dishes for visitors. The smell from the market can be felt from far away.
passage.cn: 我们镇每年十月举办美食节。当地家庭为游客做自己最拿手的菜。远远就能闻到市场的香味。

passage.en: Travel is not only about seeing new places. It also teaches you how other people live. That is why some people travel alone at least once.
passage.cn: 旅行不只是看新地方。它还让你了解别人怎么生活。这就是为什么有些人至少会独自旅行一次。

passage.en: Remember to drink enough water in summer. When you feel thirsty, your body is already short of water. Carry a bottle with you wherever you go.
passage.cn: 夏天记得喝够水。当你觉得渴的时候，身体已经缺水了。去哪儿都带上一瓶水。

passage.en: Walking is one of the safest exercises for people of any age. Thirty minutes a day is enough. You do not need any special equipment.
passage.cn: 走路是任何年龄的人最安全的运动之一。每天三十分钟就够了。不需要任何专门器材。

passage.en: Sleeping late at the weekend does not make up for a short sleep during the week. It is better to go to bed at the same time every night. Your body likes a regular plan.
passage.cn: 周末睡懒觉补不回工作日的睡眠不足。更好的做法是每天在同一个时间睡觉。身体喜欢规律的安排。

passage.en: Too much sitting is bad for your back. Stand up and move for two minutes every hour. This is more important than a long exercise once a week.
passage.cn: 久坐对腰背不好。每小时站起来活动两分钟。这比一周只做一次长时间运动更重要。

passage.en: Eating breakfast helps you think more clearly in the morning. It does not have to be a big meal. Some bread, an egg and a glass of milk are enough.
passage.cn: 吃早餐有助于上午思路清晰。不必吃很多。几片面包、一个鸡蛋和一杯牛奶就够了。

passage.en: Many people feel tired because they do not drink enough water. Others feel tired because they worry too much. Both problems can be fixed with simple habits.
passage.cn: 很多人累是因为喝水不够，另一些人累是因为想得太多。这两个问题都能用简单的习惯解决。

passage.en: Fruit and vegetables of different colours are good for you. Try to eat something green and something red every day. Colour is a simple guide to a healthy meal.
passage.cn: 不同颜色的蔬果对身体有益。每天尽量吃到绿色的和红色的。颜色是判断一餐是否健康的简单标准。

passage.en: Riding a bike to work saves money and keeps you fit. It also makes the air cleaner. In some cities, there are special roads just for bikes.
passage.cn: 骑车上班既省钱又能保持健康。还能让空气更干净。有些城市专门修了自行车道。

passage.en: A short walk after dinner is better than sitting down at once. It helps your body deal with the food. It also helps you sleep better.
passage.cn: 晚饭后稍走一走比立刻坐下要好。有助于消化，也能让你睡得更好。

passage.en: Do not use your phone for an hour before you go to sleep. The light from the screen makes it harder to fall asleep. Try reading a paper book instead.
passage.cn: 睡前一小时不要看手机。屏幕的光会让人更难入睡。不如试试读一本纸书。

passage.en: Almost everyone has a smartphone today. It makes life easier in many ways. But it can also take away a lot of your time if you are not careful.
passage.cn: 如今几乎人人都有智能手机。它在很多方面让生活更方便。但如果不注意，它也会占用你大量时间。

passage.en: Online shopping has changed the way people buy things. You can compare prices without leaving home. The only problem is that you cannot touch the goods first.
passage.cn: 网购改变了人们的购物方式。不出门就能比较价格。唯一的问题是不能先摸摸实物。

passage.en: A password should not be the name of your pet or your birthday. Use a mixture of letters and numbers. Never use the same password for everything.
passage.cn: 密码不该是宠物的名字或你的生日。用字母和数字混合。绝不要所有账号都用同一个密码。

passage.en: Many schools now use computers in the classroom. Students can find information much faster. But reading on paper is still better for deep study.
passage.cn: 现在很多学校在课堂上使用电脑。学生找资料快得多。但深入研读还是看纸质材料更好。

passage.en: Some people check their phones more than a hundred times a day. Most of those checks last only a few seconds. The habit is stronger than the need.
passage.cn: 有些人一天看手机一百多次。其中大多数每次只看了几秒。这个习惯比实际需要更强。

passage.en: Working from home saves the time you used to spend on the road. But it can be hard to stop working in the evening. Set a clear time to finish every day.
passage.cn: 在家办公省下了过去花在路上的时间。但晚上很难停下来。给每天定一个明确的收工时间。

passage.en: Cars that drive themselves are being tested in many cities. They may reduce the number of accidents. Many people, however, are still afraid of them.
passage.cn: 自动驾驶汽车正在许多城市测试。它们也许会减少事故。不过很多人仍然害怕它们。

passage.en: Old people often find new technology difficult. The buttons are too small and the words are hard to read. Some companies are now making simpler phones for them.
passage.cn: 老年人常觉得新技术很难用。按钮太小，字也看不清。现在有些公司在为他们做更简单的手机。

passage.en: Before you share a piece of news online, check where it came from. Many stories that spread quickly are not true. It takes only a minute to be sure.
passage.cn: 在网上转发一条消息前，先查查它的出处。很多传播得很快的消息并不真实。核实只要一分钟。

passage.en: Long ago, people wrote letters and waited for weeks. Now a message reaches the other side of the world in a second. What we lost is the waiting.
passage.cn: 很久以前人们写信要等几个星期。现在一条消息一秒钟就能到世界另一端。我们失去的是等待。

passage.en: Paper comes from trees, so using less paper helps the forests. Print only what you really need. Use both sides of the page when you do print.
passage.cn: 纸来自树木，少用纸就是保护森林。只打印真正需要的东西。打印时用双面。

passage.en: Plastic bags stay in the ground for hundreds of years. A cloth bag can be used thousands of times. Keep one in your bag for shopping.
passage.cn: 塑料袋在土里要几百年才分解。一个布袋子能用上千次。在包里常备一个用来购物。

passage.en: Turning off the lights when you leave a room is a small thing. But if everybody does it, the amount of energy saved is huge. Small habits add up.
passage.cn: 离开房间时关灯是件小事。但如果每个人都这样做，省下的能源是巨大的。小习惯会累积。

passage.en: Many cities are planting more trees along the streets. Trees make the air cleaner and the summer cooler. They also make the streets look friendlier.
passage.cn: 很多城市在街道两边种更多树。树让空气更干净，夏天更凉爽。也让街道看起来更亲切。

passage.en: Water is easy to waste because it seems to be everywhere. Fixing a leaking tap saves more water than you might think. It can waste a bucket a day.
passage.cn: 水随处可见，所以很容易被浪费。修好一个漏水的水龙头省下的水比你想象的多，它一天能漏掉一桶。

passage.en: The river in our town was dirty twenty years ago. The factories upstream were told to clean their waste. Now fish have come back to the water.
passage.cn: 二十年前我们镇上的河很脏。上游的工厂被要求处理废水。现在鱼又回到水里了。

passage.en: Buying local food means the food travels a shorter way. That uses less fuel and makes the air cleaner. It also helps the farmers near you.
passage.cn: 买本地食物意味着运输路程更短。消耗的燃料更少，空气更干净。也能帮到身边的农民。

passage.en: Do not throw away clothes you no longer wear. Someone else may need them. There are boxes in many neighbourhoods for old clothes.
passage.cn: 不要扔掉你不再穿的衣服。也许别人正需要。很多小区都有旧衣回收箱。

passage.en: Some animals have lost their homes because the forests were cut down. Protecting the forest is not only about trees. It is about every living thing in it.
passage.cn: 一些动物因为森林被砍而失去了家园。保护森林不只是保护树木，而是保护里面每一个生命。

passage.en: Walking or cycling for short trips is better than driving. Most trips in a city are less than three kilometres. That is a twenty minute walk.
passage.cn: 短途出行走路或骑车比开车好。城市里大多数出行不到三公里。那只是二十分钟的路程。

passage.en: The first day at a new job is always a little strange. You do not know where things are or who to ask. The best thing is to ask questions early.
passage.cn: 新工作的第一天总有点别扭。你不知道东西在哪儿，也不知道该问谁。最好的办法是早点开口问。

passage.en: A short meeting is usually better than a long one. Write down what you want to say before you start. Finish when the important points are clear.
passage.cn: 短会议通常比长会议好。开会前把要说的写下来。重要的点说清楚了就结束。

passage.en: Many companies now let their workers choose their own hours. As long as the work is done, the time matters less. This helps people with children a lot.
passage.cn: 现在很多公司让员工自己选工作时间。只要工作完成，时间就没那么重要。这对有孩子的人帮助很大。

passage.en: Being on time is one of the easiest ways to be trusted. Arriving ten minutes early shows that you care. Being late again and again is hard to forgive.
passage.cn: 守时是最容易赢得信任的方式之一。早到十分钟说明你在意。一而再地迟到很难被原谅。

passage.en: When you write a work email, keep it short and clear. Say what you want in the first two lines. Long emails are often not read carefully.
passage.cn: 写工作邮件要简短清楚。把你要说的事放在前两行。长邮件常常不会被认真看。

passage.en: It is normal to feel nervous before an interview. Prepare three stories about your past work. Then you will have something to say when you are asked.
passage.cn: 面试前感到紧张很正常。准备三个关于你过去工作的故事。被问到的时候就有话可说。

passage.en: A good team is not a group of people who never disagree. It is a group who can disagree and still work together. That takes practice.
passage.cn: 好的团队不是从不争论的一群人，而是能争论完还继续合作的一群人。这需要练习。

passage.en: When you make a mistake at work, say so quickly. Hiding it usually makes the problem bigger. People respect those who tell the truth.
passage.cn: 工作中出了错要尽快说出来。隐瞒通常会让问题变大。人们尊重说实话的人。

passage.en: Learning does not stop when you finish school. The most useful skill today is the ability to learn new things quickly. That is what keeps people employed.
passage.cn: 学习不会因为毕业而停止。今天最有用的能力是快速学会新东西。这才是让人不被淘汰的原因。

passage.en: Do not wait until the deadline to start the report. Do a small part every day. Then the last day will be calm instead of terrible.
passage.cn: 不要等截止日到了才开始写报告。每天做一小部分。这样最后一天就会很从容，而不是很痛苦。

passage.en: In many countries, people shake hands when they meet. In others, they bow or touch noses. The important thing is to show respect in your own way.
passage.cn: 在很多国家，人们见面时握手。在另一些地方，人们鞠躬或碰鼻。重要的是以你自己的方式表达尊重。

passage.en: Family dinners are important in almost every culture. People put down their phones and talk. The food is often less important than the talking.
passage.cn: 几乎每种文化里家庭聚餐都很重要。人们放下手机聊天。食物往往不如交谈重要。

passage.en: Giving a gift is never about the price. A small thing that shows you remember is the best gift. Everyone can tell the difference.
passage.cn: 送礼从来不是看价格。一件说明你记得对方的小东西才是最好的礼物。这一点人人都看得出来。

passage.en: Many Chinese people eat dumplings during the Spring Festival. The shape is like an old gold coin. Families often make them together on New Year's Eve.
passage.cn: 许多中国人在春节期间吃饺子。饺子的形状像古代的金币。家人常在除夕一起包饺子。

passage.en: Music is one of the few things that everyone understands. You do not need to know the language. The feeling comes through anyway.
passage.cn: 音乐是少数人人都懂的东西之一。你不需要懂那门语言。感受照样能传达过来。

passage.en: When you visit someone's home for the first time, bring a small gift. Fruit or flowers are always welcome. Do not bring anything too expensive.
passage.cn: 第一次去别人家做客，带一份小礼物。水果或鲜花总是受欢迎的。不要带太贵的东西。

passage.en: Old people in the countryside often know more about the weather than the forecast. They watch the birds and the clouds. Their knowledge came from a lifetime outside.
passage.cn: 乡下的老人常常比天气预报更懂天气。他们看鸟、看云。这些知识来自一辈子的户外生活。

passage.en: Many young people now learn to cook for themselves. It is cheaper than eating out and usually healthier. It is also a useful skill for life.
passage.cn: 现在很多年轻人学着自己做饭。比在外面吃便宜，通常也更健康。这也是一项受用终身的技能。

passage.en: Libraries are quieter than they used to be, but they are still free. Anyone can walk in and read. Few other places in a city are open to everyone.
passage.cn: 图书馆比以前安静了，但它们仍然免费。任何人都能进去阅读。城市里很少有其他地方对所有人开放。

passage.en: A habit takes about three weeks to form. The first week is the hardest. After that, the body begins to expect it.
passage.cn: 养成一个习惯大约需要三周。第一周最难。那之后，身体就开始期待它了。

passage.en: Many parents want their children to start learning English very early. Some begin at three years old. Others believe it is better to wait until the child reads well in the first language.
passage.cn: 很多家长想让孩子很早开始学英语。有些从三岁就开始。也有人认为，应该等孩子的母语阅读能力好了再学。

passage.en: Exams are not the only way to measure a person. They show how well you remember facts on one day. They cannot show how kind or how hard-working someone is.
passage.cn: 考试不是衡量一个人的唯一方式。它只反映某一天你对知识点的记忆程度。它看不出一个人有多善良、多努力。

passage.en: Some students do better when they study in a group. Others need to be alone to think clearly. There is no single right way to study.
passage.cn: 有些学生小组学习效果更好。有些则必须独自一人才能想清楚。学习没有唯一正确的方法。

passage.en: Teachers in many countries now use short videos in class. Students remember pictures better than words. But watching is not the same as doing.
passage.cn: 许多国家的老师现在在课上用短视频。学生对图像的记忆比文字好。但看和做是两回事。

passage.en: A student who asks questions learns faster than one who stays silent. The question shows you are thinking. Nobody in a good class will laugh at you.
passage.cn: 提问的学生比沉默的学生学得快。提问说明你在思考。在好的课堂上，没有人会嘲笑你。

passage.en: Many people forget most of what they learned at school. What stays is the way of thinking. That is the real value of education.
passage.cn: 很多人把学校里学的大部分东西都忘了。留下来的是思维方式。那才是教育真正的价值。

passage.en: Choosing a subject at university is a hard decision. Some choose what they enjoy and others what pays well. The best choice is often the one you will not regret in ten years.
passage.cn: 在大学选专业是个难做的决定。有人选自己喜欢的，有人选收入高的。最好的选择往往是十年后你不会后悔的那个。

passage.en: Homework should help you practise, not fill your evening. If it takes four hours every night, something is wrong. Talk to your teacher about it.
passage.cn: 作业应该帮你练习，而不是占满你的晚上。如果每晚要写四小时，那就有问题了。去和老师谈谈。

passage.en: Reading aloud in class makes some students very nervous. But it is one of the fastest ways to improve pronunciation. Practise at home first if you feel shy.
passage.cn: 在班上朗读会让一些学生很紧张。但这是提高发音最快的方法之一。如果你怕难为情，先在家练。

passage.en: Learning a language is not a race. Some people need two years and others need five. What matters is that you do not stop.
passage.cn: 学一门语言不是赛跑。有人需要两年，有人需要五年。重要的是不要停下来。

passage.en: More and more people are moving to big cities for work. The cities grow quickly but housing becomes expensive. Many young people share flats to save money.
passage.cn: 越来越多的人为了工作搬到大城市。城市发展很快，但住房变贵了。许多年轻人合租以省钱。

passage.en: In some neighbourhoods, people know everyone on their street. In others, nobody speaks to the neighbours for years. A simple hello can change that.
passage.cn: 有些社区里，大家认识同一条街上的每个人。另一些社区里，邻居几年都不说话。一句简单的问候就能改变这一点。

passage.en: Many old people live alone in the countryside. Their children work in the city and come home once a year. Some villages now have free meals for them.
passage.cn: 许多老人独自住在乡下。子女在城里工作，一年回一次家。现在有些村子为他们提供免费餐食。

passage.en: Traffic in the morning is worst between seven and nine. If you can leave half an hour earlier, the roads are much clearer. Many companies now start later to help.
passage.cn: 早高峰最堵的是七点到九点。如果能早走半小时，路上会通畅得多。现在很多公司推迟上班时间来帮忙缓解。

passage.en: Public transport in big cities is cheap and fast. The underground runs every two minutes at rush hour. Using it also cuts the number of cars.
passage.cn: 大城市的公共交通又便宜又快。高峰时段地铁每两分钟一班。使用它还能减少汽车数量。

passage.en: Street markets are disappearing in many cities. Supermarkets are open longer and sell everything in one place. But markets are often cheaper and fresher.
passage.cn: 许多城市的街边市场正在消失。超市营业时间更长，还能一处买齐。但市场往往更便宜、更新鲜。

passage.en: Some cities are building more bicycle lanes. The idea is to get people out of their cars for short trips. In a few cities, more people cycle than drive.
passage.cn: 一些城市在修建更多自行车道。目的是让人们短途出行不开车。在少数城市，骑车的人比开车的人还多。

passage.en: Noise is one of the biggest problems in modern cities. It comes from traffic, building work and loud music. Many people say it is worse than the air.
passage.cn: 噪音是现代城市最大的问题之一。它来自交通、施工和音乐。很多人说这比空气问题还严重。

passage.en: Many young people rent for years before they buy a home. House prices rise faster than their savings. Some decide to move to a smaller city.
passage.cn: 许多年轻人租房多年才买房。房价涨得比他们攒钱快。有些人干脆决定搬到小一点的城市。

passage.en: A good city has small parks everywhere, not one big one. People use a park that is five minutes away far more often. That is where children learn to play.
passage.cn: 好的城市到处都有小公园，而不是只有一个大公园。走路五分钟就能到的公园，人们用得最多。孩子们就在那里学会玩。

passage.en: A woman in a small town started a free library in her garage. She had only two hundred books at first. Ten years later, the whole street helps run it.
passage.cn: 一位小镇上的女士在自家车库里办了个免费图书馆。起初只有两百本书。十年后，整条街的人都在帮忙打理。

passage.en: An old man walks five kilometres every morning to buy a newspaper. He says the walk is the reason he is still healthy at eighty. He never takes the bus.
passage.cn: 一位老人每天早上走五公里去买报纸。他说，八十岁还这么健康就是因为这段路。他从不坐公交。

passage.en: A young driver stopped to help a stranger whose car had broken down. They talked for an hour while waiting. They have been friends for twenty years.
passage.cn: 一位年轻司机停下来帮一个车坏了的陌生人。等车的时候他们聊了一小时。后来他们做了二十年朋友。

passage.en: A teacher kept every letter her students wrote to her. She has boxes of them in her house. Some of those students now bring their own children to her.
passage.cn: 一位老师保存着学生写给她的每一封信。家里有好几箱。当年的一些学生现在把自己的孩子也送到她那儿。

passage.en: A boy who could not afford a bike walked ten kilometres to school. His neighbour noticed and gave him an old one. He still remembers the neighbour's name.
passage.cn: 一个买不起自行车的男孩走十公里去上学。邻居注意到了，送了他一辆旧的。他至今记得那位邻居的名字。

passage.en: A shop owner in the market gives free vegetables to old people on Sundays. He has done it for fifteen years. He says it costs him almost nothing.
passage.cn: 市场里一位摊主每周日给老人免费送菜。他已经做了十五年。他说这几乎不花他什么钱。

passage.en: A nurse worked in the same hospital for forty years. She knew the names of most of the families there. When she retired, the street held a party for her.
passage.cn: 一位护士在同一家医院工作了四十年。她记得那里大多数人家属的名字。她退休时，整条街为她办了聚会。

passage.en: A farmer planted trees on a bare hill every spring for thirty years. Now the hill is a small forest. He says he only did a little each year.
passage.cn: 一位农民连续三十年每年春天在光秃秃的山上种树。现在那座山成了一小片森林。他说他每年只做一点点。

passage.en: A student failed the exam twice and almost gave up. His teacher told him to try one more time. He passed on the third try and became an engineer.
passage.cn: 一个学生两次考试都没过，几乎放弃了。老师让他再试一次。他第三次通过了，后来成了工程师。

passage.en: A woman learned to read at the age of sixty. She had never had the chance as a child. She now reads a book every week.
passage.cn: 一位女士六十岁才学会读书。她小时候一直没有机会。现在她每周读一本书。

passage.en: Bees do much more for us than making honey. They carry pollen from flower to flower. Without them, many fruits would disappear from our tables.
passage.cn: 蜜蜂为我们做的事远不止酿蜜。它们把花粉从一朵花带到另一朵。没有它们，很多水果会从我们的餐桌上消失。

passage.en: Some birds fly thousands of kilometres every year. They use the sun and the stars to find the way. Nobody is sure how they learn the route.
passage.cn: 有些鸟每年飞行数千公里。它们靠太阳和星星辨别方向。没有人确切知道它们是怎么学会这条路线的。

passage.en: Cats sleep for about sixteen hours a day. They are most active at night. That is why they are awake when you want to sleep.
passage.cn: 猫每天大约睡十六个小时。它们在夜间最活跃。这就是为什么你想睡的时候它们正精神。

passage.en: Elephants live in family groups led by the oldest female. The group remembers where the water is. Young elephants learn by following.
passage.cn: 大象以家族为单位生活，由最年长的母象带领。族群记得水源在哪里。小象通过跟随来学习。

passage.en: The number of wild tigers has fallen sharply in the last century. Forests were cut and the animals were hunted. Now some countries are working to protect them.
passage.cn: 上世纪野生老虎的数量急剧下降。森林被砍伐，老虎被猎杀。现在一些国家正在努力保护它们。

passage.en: Dogs can smell far better than humans. Some are trained to find people under snow. Others can tell if a person is ill.
passage.cn: 狗的嗅觉远比人类灵敏。有些狗被训练在雪下找人。还有些能察觉人生病了。

passage.en: Sea turtles return to the same beach where they were born. They swim thousands of kilometres to get there. Nobody knows exactly how they find it.
passage.cn: 海龟会回到自己出生的那片海滩。它们要游数千公里才能到达。没有人确切知道它们是怎么找到的。

passage.en: Fish in the deep sea make their own light. The light helps them find food and hide from danger. Some of them look like small lamps.
passage.cn: 深海里的鱼能自己发光。这光帮它们找食物、躲避危险。有些鱼看起来就像小灯笼。

passage.en: A tree can live for hundreds of years. It gives shade, food and clean air. Cutting one down takes only a few minutes.
passage.cn: 一棵树能活几百年。它提供阴凉、食物和干净的空气。砍倒它只需要几分钟。

passage.en: Many people keep a small plant on their desk. Looking at green things helps people feel calmer. It also makes the air a little cleaner.
passage.cn: 很多人在桌上养一盆小植物。看着绿色的东西让人更平静。也能让空气干净一点。

passage.en: Breakfast is the meal most people skip. The morning is busy and nobody feels hungry. But a small breakfast makes the whole morning easier.
passage.cn: 早餐是大多数人会跳过的一餐。早上忙，也没人觉得饿。但吃一点早餐会让整个上午轻松很多。

passage.en: In the south, rice is the main food. In the north, people eat more noodles and bread. Both have been the same for hundreds of years.
passage.cn: 南方以米饭为主食。北方人吃更多面食和馒头。这两者都延续了几百年。

passage.en: Fresh food does not stay good for long. That is why markets sell it quickly and cheaply at the end of the day. You can save a lot by going late.
passage.cn: 生鲜放不久。所以市场在收摊时会便宜快卖。晚点去买能省不少钱。

passage.en: Too much sugar is hidden in drinks. A bottle of sweet tea may hold ten spoons of sugar. Water or tea without sugar is a much better choice.
passage.cn: 饮料里藏着很多糖。一瓶甜茶可能含十勺糖。白水或不加糖的茶是更好的选择。

passage.en: Cooking at home is a skill that saves money and time. You can make a simple meal in twenty minutes. It also lets you control what you eat.
passage.cn: 自己做饭是一项省钱又省时间的技能。二十分钟就能做一顿简单的饭。还能自己控制吃什么。

passage.en: Different countries have very different breakfasts. Some eat bread and cheese and others eat soup. What they share is starting the day with family or quiet.
passage.cn: 不同国家的早餐差别很大。有人吃面包奶酪，有人喝汤。共同点是和家人一起、或安静地开始一天。

passage.en: Vegetables lose some vitamins when they are cooked for a long time. Light cooking keeps more of them. It also keeps the taste and the colour.
passage.cn: 蔬菜煮太久会损失一些维生素。快炒能保留更多。也能保住口感和颜色。

passage.en: Many people eat too quickly and then feel too full. It takes about twenty minutes for the body to feel full. Slowing down makes you eat less.
passage.cn: 很多人吃得太快，结果撑得难受。身体大约需要二十分钟才会觉得饱。放慢速度会让你吃得更少。

passage.en: Food waste is a big problem in rich countries. Shops throw away food that is still good. Some of them now give it to people who need it.
passage.cn: 在富裕国家，食物浪费是个大问题。商店扔掉还很好的食物。现在有些店把它们送给需要的人。

passage.en: Tea was drunk in China long before it reached Europe. It was once so expensive that only rich people could buy it. Now it is the most common drink in the world.
passage.cn: 茶在中国被饮用远早于它传到欧洲。它曾经贵到只有富人才买得起。如今它是世界上最常见的饮品。

passage.en: The first underground railway opened in London in eighteen sixty three. It was pulled by steam engines and the air was terrible. Today, hundreds of cities have one.
passage.cn: 第一条地铁一八六三年在伦敦开通。它由蒸汽机车牵引，空气糟透了。如今数百个城市都有地铁。

passage.en: Driving in an unfamiliar city is stressful. The road signs are different and the traffic is heavy. Taking a bus or a taxi is often easier.
passage.cn: 在陌生的城市开车很有压力。路标不一样，交通也拥挤。坐公交或打车往往更省心。

passage.en: High speed trains have changed travel in many countries. A trip that used to take a day now takes three hours. People can go and come back the same day.
passage.cn: 高铁改变了许多国家的出行。过去需要一整天的路程现在三小时就到。人们当天就能来回。

passage.en: Long flights make people feel tired because of the dry air. Drinking water helps more than coffee. Standing up and walking also helps.
passage.cn: 长途飞行因为空气干燥让人很累。喝水比喝咖啡更有用。站起来走动也有帮助。

passage.en: In some cities, buses have their own lane. They move faster than cars at rush hour. This is one reason more people are willing to take them.
passage.cn: 有些城市公交有专用道。高峰时段比汽车跑得快。这也是更多人愿意坐公交的原因之一。

passage.en: Parking is one of the main problems of city driving. A car is parked for more than twenty hours a day. That means most of the time it is just taking space.
passage.cn: 停车是城市开车的主要难题之一。一辆车一天有二十多个小时是停着的。也就是说大部分时间它只是在占地方。

passage.en: Many airports are now far from the cities they serve. The bus or train to the airport can take longer than the flight. Always check the whole trip time.
passage.cn: 现在很多机场离它服务的城市很远。去机场的公交或地铁可能比飞行时间还长。一定要算上整段时间。

passage.en: Riding a bicycle in heavy traffic can be dangerous. Wear something bright so drivers can see you. Keep a safe distance from the doors of parked cars.
passage.cn: 在拥挤车流中骑车有危险。穿亮色的衣服让司机看见你。与路边停放车辆的车门保持安全距离。

passage.en: A long walk is the cheapest and healthiest way to travel. It requires no ticket and no fuel. It also lets you see a city in a way drivers never do.
passage.cn: 长距离步行是最便宜也最健康的出行方式。不用买票，不用加油。还能让你以开车人永远看不到的方式看一座城市。

passage.en: When you travel abroad, learn a few words of the local language. Even hello and thank you make a difference. People treat you better when you try.
passage.cn: 出国旅行时，学几句当地语言。哪怕只是你好和谢谢也会不一样。你愿意尝试，别人就会对你更好。

passage.en: Saving a little every month is easier than saving a lot once a year. Ten per cent of your pay is a good place to start. The habit matters more than the amount.
passage.cn: 每月存一点比一年存一大笔容易。从收入的一成开始就不错。习惯比数目更重要。

passage.en: Buying something because it is on sale is not always saving money. If you did not need it, you spent all of it. The question is whether you would buy it at the full price.
passage.cn: 因为打折而买并不一定是省钱。如果你本来不需要，那就是全花掉了。问题在于：原价你会买吗？

passage.en: Many young people spend more than they earn on the first job. The first month is the most dangerous. Write down what you spend for one month.
passage.cn: 很多年轻人第一份工作时花得比挣得多。第一个月最危险。记一个月的账看看。

passage.en: A cheap thing that breaks in a month is not cheap. Ask how long it will last before you compare prices. The price per year is the honest number.
passage.cn: 一个月就坏的便宜货其实不便宜。比价之前先问能用多久。折算成每年的花费才是诚实的数字。

passage.en: Comparing prices online takes only a few minutes. The same thing can cost twice as much in different shops. Check before you pay.
passage.cn: 在网上比价只要几分钟。同样的东西在不同店里可能贵一倍。付钱前先查一下。

passage.en: Credit cards make buying easy and paying painful. It is easy to forget that the money is borrowed. Spend only what you could pay today.
passage.cn: 信用卡让买东西很容易，还钱很痛苦。人很容易忘记那钱是借来的。只花你今天能付得起的钱。

passage.en: Learning to cook, to fix small things and to sew saves a lot of money each year. These skills were once taught at home. Many schools no longer teach them.
passage.cn: 学会做饭、修小东西和缝补，每年能省不少钱。这些技能过去在家里教。很多学校已经不教了。

passage.en: Second hand goods are much better value than most people think. Books, furniture and bicycles are often almost new. The money saved can go to something you need more.
passage.cn: 二手货的性价比比大多数人想的高。书、家具和自行车常常几乎是新的。省下的钱可以用在更需要的地方。

passage.en: Money worries keep many people awake at night. Writing down the real numbers often makes the problem smaller. Most worries are bigger than the facts.
passage.cn: 钱的烦恼让很多人夜里睡不着。把真实数字写下来，问题往往就显得小了。大多数担忧都比事实要大。

passage.en: The best time to plan for old age is when you are young. Small amounts grow slowly but surely. Starting ten years earlier changes everything.
passage.cn: 为养老做规划最好的时候是年轻的时候。小钱会慢慢但稳定地增长。早十年开始，结果完全不同。

passage.en: Many students spend a summer helping in a village school. They teach English and organise games. Most of them say they learned more than they taught.
passage.cn: 很多学生用一个暑假去乡村学校帮忙。他们教英语、组织游戏。多数人说自己学到的比教的还多。

passage.en: A group of neighbours started cleaning a river every month. At first only five people came. Now more than sixty people join.
passage.cn: 一群邻居开始每月清理一条河。起初只来了五个人。现在有六十多人参加。

passage.en: Some restaurants give their unsold food to a local charity at closing time. Nothing is thrown away. The charity sends it to families who need it.
passage.cn: 有些餐馆在打烊时把没卖完的食物送给当地慈善机构。什么都不会被扔掉。慈善机构把它送到需要的人手里。

passage.en: Blood donation takes only ten minutes. One donation can help up to three patients. Most healthy adults can donate several times a year.
passage.cn: 献血只需要十分钟。一次献血最多能帮助三位病人。大多数健康成年人一年可以献几次。

passage.en: Reading to old people in a care home is a simple way to help. Many of them can no longer see well. They still enjoy stories very much.
passage.cn: 在养老院给老人读书是种简单的帮忙方式。他们中很多人视力已经不好。但他们仍然非常喜欢听故事。

passage.en: A community garden turns an empty lot into a meeting place. People grow vegetables and share them. Children learn where food comes from.
passage.cn: 社区花园把一块空地变成了聚会的地方。人们种菜并分享。孩子们由此知道食物从哪儿来。

passage.en: Volunteers cleaned up the beach and found more than two hundred plastic bottles. The next month they found only half as many. People change when they see the result.
passage.cn: 志愿者清理海滩，捡到两百多个塑料瓶。第二个月只捡到一半。人们看到结果就会改变。

passage.en: Many people give money but have no time. Others have time but no money. Both kinds of help are needed and both are useful.
passage.cn: 很多人愿意出钱但没时间。另一些人愿意花时间但没钱。两种帮助都被需要，都有用。

passage.en: A damaged bicycle can be repaired and given to a student who has none. One repair shop in the city does this every spring. They have given away over five hundred.
passage.cn: 一辆坏了的自行车可以修好，送给没有车的学生。城里有一家修车铺每年春天都这么做。他们已经送出五百多辆。

passage.en: Helping someone does not have to be organised. Holding a door or carrying a bag is also help. What matters is that you notice.
passage.cn: 帮助别人不一定要有组织。扶一下门、提一下袋子也是帮助。重要的是你留意到了。

passage.en: Most people are afraid of speaking in public. The fear is normal and it gets smaller with practice. The first three times are the hardest.
passage.cn: 大多数人都害怕当众讲话。这种害怕很正常，练多了就会变小。头三次是最难的。

passage.en: Comparing yourself with others is a quick way to feel bad. Someone will always be ahead of you. Compare with who you were last year instead.
passage.cn: 和别人比较是让自己难受的最快方式。总有人走在你前面。不如和去年的自己比。

passage.en: Big changes start with very small actions. Reading two pages a day becomes a book a month. The size of the first step does not matter.
passage.cn: 大的改变从很小的行动开始。每天读两页，一个月就是一本书。第一步有多小并不重要。

passage.en: Failure teaches more than success, but it hurts more too. The useful part is what you do the next week. Most successful people failed many times.
passage.cn: 失败比成功教给你的更多，但也更疼。真正有用的是你接下来那一周做了什么。大多数成功的人都失败过很多次。

passage.en: Waiting for the perfect moment is the same as never starting. The conditions will never be perfect. Start with what you have today.
passage.cn: 等待完美时机等于永远不开始。条件永远不会完美。用你今天有的东西开始吧。

passage.en: Doing one thing at a time is faster than doing three things badly. Your brain cannot really work on two hard tasks at once. Finish one, then start the next.
passage.cn: 一次做一件事比同时把三件事搞砸要快。大脑其实无法同时处理两个难任务。做完一件再开始下一件。

passage.en: Being busy is not the same as being productive. Many people work all day and finish nothing important. Ask what actually moved forward.
passage.cn: 忙碌不等于高效。很多人忙了一整天却没完成什么重要的事。问问自己：到底哪件事真的推进了。

passage.en: Everyone feels bored and tired with their study sometimes. That feeling is not a sign that you should stop. It is usually a sign that you need a rest.
passage.cn: 每个人在学习中都会有觉得枯燥疲惫的时候。那种感觉不是你该停下的信号。它通常只是说明你需要休息。

passage.en: You will forget what you do not use. This is true of languages, of skills and even of people. Use it or lose it is more than a saying.
passage.cn: 不使用的东西就会忘掉。语言如此，技能如此，连人也是如此。用进废退不只是一句俗话。

passage.en: Progress is not a straight line. There are weeks when nothing seems to improve. Then one day you notice you have moved a long way.
passage.cn: 进步不是一条直线。有些星期看起来毫无起色。然后某一天你忽然发现，自己已经走了很远。

3] Researchers in Iceland found a new way of tackling climate change by pumping carbon dioxide underground and turning it into stone.
Other carbon capture and storage methods store carbon dioxide as a gas.
But problems include a high cost and concern about leaks.
This new method of burying carbon dioxide and turning it into stone is cheaper and more secure, the Guardian reports.

To turn carbon dioxide into stone, researchers with the CarbFix project pumped the gas into volcanic rock and sped up the natural process, in which the volcanic rock reacts with gas and forms carbon minerals.
The gas turned into solid in just two years, much faster than the hundreds or thousands of years researchers had predicted.
The research took place at Iceland's Hellisheidi power plant.
Already, the project in Iceland has been increased in scale to bury 10,000 tons of carbon dioxide each year.
4] One potential difficulty is that for each ton of carbon dioxide buried, the technique requires 25 tons of water.
However, the lead researcher said sea water could be used.

Those who are relatively old, compared to their classmates, have certain advantages over them.
Previous research has found older students achieve better results.
They are also more likely to attend university and become professional athletes, chief executives and even important politicians.
23] But the Australian researchers wanted to discover what was driving these differences.
They suspected older, more mature students obtained more self-confidence than their peers because they achieved better grades.
